name: Birdsquirrel
appearance: A tiny brown bird with clawed feet and a large, curling squirrel tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Adventure with Muk, Monsters, unnumbered sheet 30.
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The birdsquirrel has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally of the birdsquirrel is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Attack +4. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Claws. Attack +4. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Ecology: Birdsquirrel is devoted to Muk. It may be a one-of-a-kind creation of the wizard Doonwaggle.

name: Boontu Monkey
appearance: A tiny chestnut monkey with pale cheeks, gripping fingers and a curling tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Adventure with Muk, Monsters, unnumbered sheet 30.
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The Boontu monkey has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally of the Boontu monkey is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Attack +1. On a hit, deal 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.
sections.Ecology: These wary monkeys search constantly for food and leave the sacred golden nuts on their home tree alone. A local story says a dryad transformed thieves into the monkeys after catching them stealing her nuts.

name: Two-Headed Plesiosaurus
appearance: A gray-blue marine reptile with two long necks, four broad flippers and a short tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, The Tortle Package, High Horn, pp. 18, 19.
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 1 hour.
Two heads. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned or knocked unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use its action to make two Bite attacks, one per head.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter: It hunts around the High Horn shipwrecks at high tide and retreats to the northern strait as the tide falls.

otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Languages none.

name: Wolf
appearance: A gray-brown wolf with pointed ears, a pale muzzle and a thick tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDEX1-01 - Defiance in Phlan, Missions 2 and 5, Monster/NPC Statistics, pp. 15, 31.
sections.Traits:
Keen Hearing and Smell. The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics. The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally of the wolf is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit this way falls prone on a failed DC 11 Strength save.
sections.Encounter:
Mission 2, area 2C. Three goblins guard two caged wolves. A goblin can unlock a cage as an action. For a weak party, remove one goblin and one wolf. For a strong party, replace one wolf with a worg. For a very strong party, replace both with uncaged worgs.
Mission 5, area 3B. The guard room has a large dog using these Wolf statistics. Add one wolf for a very strong party.

otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Languages none.
